title: SystemDocument
description: The serialized form of a power system: every component, the association tables linking them, and the sidecar file holding time series values. Each component blob is self-contained: a per-unit basis is resolved against that blob's own basis-selector property and base_power, never a document-wide table. `time_series_associations` carries series metadata; `time_series_storage_file` names the sidecar.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the system.

components.description: Components grouped by type name, e.g. {"ACBus": [...]}. Keys are the schema's title, sorted for deterministic output. An unknown type must fail conversion.

supplemental_attributes.description: Supplemental attributes as one flat array, not bucketed by type. `supplemental_attribute_associations` carries the link and the attribute_type discriminator.

supplemental_attribute_associations.description: Links each plain supplemental attribute (e.g. EmissionsData, GeographicInfo) to the entity it describes. One row per (attribute, entity) pair.

plant_associations.description: Links a power plant attribute (ThermalPowerPlant, HydroPowerPlant, RenewablePowerPlant, CombinedCycleFractional) to a unit and its group within the plant.

combined_cycle_associations.description: Links a CombinedCycleBlock plant to a CT or CA unit, identifying which HRSG the unit feeds into or receives from.

service_associations.description: Links a service to one component that contributes to it. One row per (service, member) pair.

trading_hub_associations.description: Links a trading hub to one entity: a member bus, or a transaction settling there. One row per (hub, member) pair. Optional, defaults to empty.

time_series_associations.description: Time series metadata rows, one per (series, owner) association. Each names the store holding its values; `time_series_storage_file` is the sidecar name.

ext.description: Source data no schema field claims, keyed by component id. A consumer must consult a declared ignore list: a listed key is skipped, an unlisted key errors.

time_series_storage_file.description: Basename of the sidecar holding time series values, or null if none. A name, not a path: resolved relative to the document.
